newComponents.name: TitleCover
newComponents.purpose: Stands in for a cover image: the title and the author set on a colored block, so the detail page has a visual anchor without uploads.
newComponents.whyNotExisting: Avatar draws initials in a circle of at most 56 px, and Card is a surface for content; neither sets a title in a 2:3 block.

parts.name: title
parts.description: The title, up to four lines, then cut with an ellipsis.

parts.name: author
parts.description: The author on one line at the bottom.

newComponents.layout: A 160 by 240 block at every width. The title sits at the top and the author at the bottom, both 16 inside the edges and 8 apart at the least.
newComponents.behavior: Static. It shows the title and the author it is given; it has no interaction and no other state.
